name: Claude
difficultyWhy: Not an OAuth app. Do not try to register an OAuth app for Claude. Third party access is an API key from the Claude Console, with no OAuth approval queue.
approvalWait: None. There is no OAuth approval stage for a Claude API key.
accountNeeded: Claude Console account at platform.claude.com, separate from a claude.ai chat account, plus a payment method for API credits
cost: Free to create a key. API use is billed per token from prepaid Console credits, separate from a Claude chat subscription.

steps.title: Create a Claude Console account
steps.detail: Sign in at platform.claude.com, or create an account. This is separate from claude.ai chat, with separate billing.
steps.blockerTip: A claude.ai chat login alone does not give you API access. Use the Console account.

steps.title: Add credits before testing
steps.detail: Open Settings, Billing, and check your balance before your first call. API billing is separate from a Claude subscription.
steps.blockerTip: At a zero balance, API calls will not work. Add credits first.

steps.title: Create one named API key
steps.detail: Open API keys, click Create key, name it after the app, choose an expiration, and choose a linked account. Use a service account key for a shared app, CI, or production service.
steps.blockerTip: If Create key is greyed out, your role cannot create keys. Ask an organization admin.

steps.title: Store the key safely, once
steps.detail: Copy the full key, starting with sk-ant-, straight into a secrets manager and set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. The Console shows it only once.
steps.blockerTip: Never put the key in client code, a public repo, logs, or agent output. If you lose it, create a new key and delete the old one.

steps.title: Test one call, then stop
steps.detail: Send one test request with the key as a Bearer token. A 401 means a wrong, expired, or revoked key, or trailing whitespace. A multi workspace key must also send the workspace header.
steps.blockerTip: Do not reuse Claude Code or claude.ai OAuth tokens in another product. Those OAuth tokens are locked to Claude Code and Claude.ai.

timeline.note: Self serve, no approval queue for a key.
There is no third party OAuth app to approve.

checklist.item: Claude Console account created, separate from claude.ai
API key named after the app, with a service account for shared use
Key stored in a secrets manager, never in client code

blockers.fix: Your role cannot create keys. Ask an organization admin, or ask for a service account key.

blockers.blocker: Key lost after closing the dialog
blockers.fix: There is no reveal button. Create a new key, store it at once, and delete the old one.
Check for a wrong or expired key and trailing whitespace, and send the workspace header if the key is not scoped to one workspace.
A personal key acts as you and stops if you leave the organization. Use a service account key for shared workloads.

humanMust: Add a payment method and credits

managedAppNote: There is no managed OAuth app for Claude. If you use Composio, its Claude toolkit still uses your API key, not an OAuth app.
